critical_code_review_comments: Restructure is clean: real /app/frontend and /app/backend directories, vite.config.emergent.js removed and overrides folded into vite.config.js, symlink removed. This should satisfy Emergent's deploy pipeline that copies source into a build context.

Non-blocking build warnings: (a) three service files (auth/individual/mutual) are both statically and dynamically imported, so the dynamic imports won't split — either remove the dynamic imports in verify-email.js/dashboard.js or make imports consistent; (b) main JS chunk >500 kB — consider manualChunks or code-splitting Firebase/Supabase. Purely cosmetic, not a deploy blocker.

rca of the issue: Previous deploy failure ('read env file frontend/.env: no such file or directory') was caused by /app/frontend being a symlink to /app; the Emergent deploy pipeline tars/copies the source and does not follow symlinks in the same way as the preview supervisor, so frontend/.env resolved to /app/.env in preview but was absent in the copied build context. Fix (verified): moved the Vite app into a REAL /app/frontend/ directory, folded vite.config.emergent.js overrides into vite.config.js, removed the symlink.
